Subject: Marquette Office Partners - Referral Required

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the submission on Marquette Office Partners. I've reviewed the information and have everything I need to move forward.

However, I do need to refer this to our senior underwriting team due to the five-year incurred losses exceeding $250K. This is above my binding authority.

I'll present this internally and get back to you within 2-3 business days with next steps. In the meantime, if you'd like to explore other options, you might consider reaching out to a specialty market that focuses on higher-loss accounts—they may be able to provide more competitive terms.

I'll be in touch soon.

Best regards,
[Underwriter name]
